sentences.en: Algeria needs more fertile lands to feed its growing population.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要更多的肥沃土地来养活不断增长的人口。

sentences.en: The settlers learned that the land in the valley was fertile.
sentences.zh: 定居者发现山谷里的土地非常肥沃。

sentences.en: Agriculture is developed in the most fertile lands of the region.
sentences.zh: 农业在该地区最肥沃的土地上得到了发展。

senses.zh: 富饶的，肥沃的；能生育的

mnemonic: fert=fer（带来）+ile→能带来粮食→肥沃的
